A measured experiment

😀 Cicero called the pilot promising but uncertain. Researchers measured travel time in two towns, retained the original observations, and warned that a small comparison cannot establish causation.

What remains unknown

The authors wrote: Keep the uncertainty visible. A larger controlled trial is needed before drawing a general conclusion.

  • Measure the same outcomes.
  • Report every limitation.
